map.距考试总天数 = ceil((10-01 − 09-10)) = 21 天；\n: Total days to exam = ceil((10-01 − 09-10)) = 21 days; of these, counting Monday–Friday as weekdays ≈ 15 days, weekends 6 days (holidays not deducted); if 10-01 falls on the National Day holiday, checking “deduct statutory holidays” removes the holiday from weekdays and counts it as holiday. (Another example, exam 09-30: total 20 days, weekdays ≈14, weekends 6.)
map.倒计时为什么用 ceil 而不是四舍五入？: Why does the countdown use ceil instead of rounding?
map.剩余天数向上取整（不足一天按一天计）是为了不低估备考时间——哪怕只差几小时也算「: Rounding the remaining days up (less than a day counts as a day) avoids underestimating study time — even if only a few hours remain it still counts as “one day left”, reminding the candidate to review that day; this is a conservative and safe rounding strategy.
map.本工具内置常见法定节假日（如国庆 10-01~10-07、春节等）用于扣除，但每: This tool has built-in common statutory holidays (e.g. National Day 10-01~10-07, Spring Festival, etc.) for deduction, but each year’s specific adjusted schedule follows the State Council’s announcement for that year, and makeup workdays are not auto-extended; for important exams follow the school/exam institution calendar — results are for planning reference only.
map.考试倒计时是一款教育学习领域的在线工具。: Exam Countdown is an online tool in the education and learning domain.
map.从可复习天数中扣除法定节假日（仅内置 2026 年近似表，不含调休补班）: Deduct statutory holidays from study days (built-in 2026 approximation only; adjusted make-up workdays excluded)
map.节假日口径：勾选「扣除法定节假日」后，仅按内置 2026 年主要节假日近似表从可: Holiday rule: “Deduct statutory holidays” subtracts only the built-in 2026 major-holiday approximation, excluding adjusted make-up workdays; if weekends are also counted, holidays falling on weekends are not double-counted as study days. Years without a built-in table are not deducted and are flagged in the results.
map.快捷入口只保留未来考试：内置快捷按钮按当前日期过滤，已过期日期不再显示，也不会把: Quick entries keep only future exams: built-in buttons are filtered by the current date, so expired dates are hidden and never force-filled into the input; enter the next confirmed exam date manually when needed.
map.仅内置 2026 年主要节假日近似表用于扣减，不含调休补班；每年具体安排以国务院: Only the built-in 2026 major-holiday approximation is deducted, excluding adjusted make-up workdays; each year’s exact schedule follows the State Council announcement. Years without a built-in table are not deducted and are flagged in the results; for important exams follow the school/institution calendar.
map.为什么快捷考试按钮会变少？: Why do the quick exam buttons disappear over time?
map.快捷入口按“日期 ≥ 今天”动态渲染，过期项自动隐藏；若一个都不剩，页面会提示自: Quick entries are rendered dynamically for dates today or later, and expired ones are hidden; if none remain, the page asks you to enter the exam name and date manually. This prevents past dates from being force-filled and producing a negative countdown.
